classes.subject: COMM

notes.descrlong:
Prerequisite: COMM 4951. Permission of instructor required. Enrollment limited to: Communication majors. Students must enroll in both COMM 4951 (fall) and COMM 4952 (winter) to receive a final letter grade. Seniors graduating in the fall semester are not eligible to enroll in this class since the final grade is assigned in the winter term, after graduation.  	
Students are expected to travel to California for SiliCOMM. Details of the trip, expenses, etc. can be found here https://communication.cals.cornell.edu/undergraduate-program/nycomm-lacomm/ . For Fall 2019/Winter 2020, the trip will be Sunday, January 5th, through Thursday, January 9th.

classes.description: This winter session field trip is an extension of fall seminar COMM 4951 which introduces students to the world of professional communication. During this trip, students travel to a rotating city (e.g. Los Angeles, San Francisco) to meet with alumni working in the communication field. Previous companies visited include: LA Chargers. Students will review relevant background information about each company prior to the trip to include Skype meetings with other communication and media firms.
classes.catalogComments: Students must enroll in both COMM 4951 (fall) and COMM 4952 (winter) to receive a final letter grade. Students will receive a placeholder grade (R) in the fall and upon completion of COMM 4952, the R grade will be replaced with a letter grade. Contact professors for more information.
catalogOutcomes: Identify the roles of each firm in the communication industry, its challenges, and key drivers for the future.
Discuss professional opportunities with working alumni through a variety of networking channels.
Evaluate yourself navigating a career within communication industries.
Construct and present an ePortfolio which demonstrates key communicative skills.
Evaluate how communication industries can contribute to sustainable development goals.
